## Lexicon Pharmaceuticals to Participate at Three Upcoming Investor Conferences


September 1, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.lexpharma.com/node/17216/pdf)


THE WOODLANDS, Texas, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lexicon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: LXRX) today announced that company management will present at three upcoming investor conferences taking place in New York, NY:


**Citi 2026 Biopharma Back to School Conference**
September 9, 2026, 11:20–11:55 AM (Eastern Time)


**2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference**
September 10, 2026, 3:20–3:50 PM (Eastern Time)


**H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference**
September 14, 2026, 9:00–9:30 AM (Eastern Time)


The live events and replays of the presentations can be accessed via the Events page on the company’s website at[https://investors.lexpharma.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mV6rc8lKqXLcXSx64o97WBu6QrXRQfoE14T6RVOmTrwvdwrkKZiasUavsir68zNLC3vEhsnyuW0E2VGmGuhYlf1RlPzKtkjrNhP-d7YJr020wTGHArBz5Xpn8lbc3TsK) .


**About Lexicon Pharmaceuticals**
Lexicon is a biopharmaceutical company with a mission of pioneering medicines that transform patients’ lives. Lexicon has a pipeline of drug candidates in discovery, preclinical, and clinical development in neuropathic pain, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), obesity and metabolic disorders, and other cardiometabolic indications. For additional information, please visit[www.lexpharma.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=r5DJIUvE2gROmSp_YyY9pBWDxLSUcJZahB0IMQkIFCrhk9UX5xJYYmVTvBpiB5UOVwLxQlsPT9-SpI9rk3t2EL66guP5Jk5hsXYmFYWsE0A=) .
